content: Igar-bur-birigined

Moisés Israel-dulemarga sogdebalid: “An bemar-odurdakmalaga, we-Igarmar-Mamaid, we-Igarmar-uklesad, be-Bab-Dummad-Jehová bemarga uksad. Bemar we-yar-bemarga-uklenaidse dogdele, a-Igarba be nanadii gumalo.

Be-mimmigan, be-wagan, bela-bemar we-napneggi-dula-gudiidgi be-Bab-Dummad-Jehová-dobee nanamalo. Bela Igarmar-Mamaid, Igarmar-an-bemarga-uked, aba be nanamalo, adi, we-napneggi suitibaksaar dula be gudii gumalagar.

Israel-dulemar, degisoggu be nue-itomar, gatik Bab-Dummad-sogedba be nanadii gumar. Adi, yar-gadi-ibmar-sanmakedgine, yar-napa-nuedgine, be nued gudii gudmaloed, egi be dula-bukidar-nikumai gudmaloed. Igi be-dadgan-e-Bab-Dummad-Jehová bemarga-yar-ukedseye sogsagusa, deyob guegar.
”Israel-dulemar, nue be itomar: Anmar-Bab-Dummad-Jehová, unnila wargwenna gued.
”Be-Bab-Dummad-Jehová bela-belad be-gwagegi, be-san-burbagi, degine, bela be-ganguedgi be sabguoed.
”Emi-ibagi, we-gayaburba an bemarga-sognaid, nue be-gwage-ulubgi be sedii imakmalo.
We-gayaburbamar, be-mimmigangala, be gannar-gannar-sogdii nanamalo. Be-neggi be gudiile, igarba be gudiile, be megesokalile, degine, be gwisgualile, ega be sogdii nanao.
We-Igarmala be-argangi wilubganyob be atinnar-nasiko. Degine, be-bebegi wilubganyob be nasikbalo.
Degine, be-neg-buarmargi be narmakbalo, degi, be-yawagakmargi be narmakbalo.”
Bab-Jehováʼba-ibsaedgi sunmaklenaid

Moisés Israel-dulemarga sogdebalid: “Be-Bab-Dummad-Jehová, be-dadgan-Abrahamʼga, Isaacʼga, degi, Jacobʼga, yar-ukedseye sogsagusad. Bab-Jehová a-yargine be-odononimaloed. A-yalagi, neggwebur-dummagan bubukwad, neggweburmar-nue-nasgumamai nanaed. A-neggweburmar, gwen bemar sobsasurmaladid.

Degine, a-yargi negmar-bubukwad ibmarmar-nuegan-nika nanaed. A-ibmarmar, gwen bemar onmaksasurmaladid. Degine, dia-dummagan-bukwa nanabalid, gwen bemar akwissurmaladid. Uva-dubmar, degi, olivoʼmar digar nanaibalid, gwen bemar digsasurmaladid. ”Amar bela bemar gutemalale, nue immeledmalale,
nue salakarmar, melle Bab-Jehová-iedmalo. Ar bemar Egipto-yargi maiga-wilebukwamargua, Bab-Jehová bemar-onosgusad.
”Be-Bab-Dummad-Jehová-e-nug be odummodii nanamalo, eba be ibsadii nanamalo. Be ibmar ise-sogar-imakbiele, Bab-Dummad-nugginbi be imako.
Melle be dule-be-dikarba-bubukwamalad-e-bab-dummaganba be namalo.
Ar be-Bab-Dummad-Jehová bemar-abargi-gudiidi, nue-noberbadid. Ar bab-dummad-baid be-Bab-Dummadga be imakalile, Bab-Jehová-sabsur-ourwega be imakoed. Ar degigudele, we-napneggi bela bemar-ogilogoed.
”Bemar Masahʼye-neg-nugadgi Bab-Dummad-Jehová-wilubdaksayobi, melle be Bab-Jehová-wilubdakmalo.
Nue salakarmar, be-Bab-Dummad-Jehová-Igarmar-Mamaidba be nanadii gumalo. Igarmar-Islidikidba, Bab-Dummad-Sogedba-Igar-Maidba be nanadii gumalo.

Be-Bab-Jehová-asabin ibmar-innikimaladbi be imakdii gumar, ibmar-nueganbi be imakdii gumar, adi, bemar, nued gudii gumalagar. Degine, Bab-Jehová be-dadganga ise-sogar yar-nued-ukoye-sogsadi be sumalagar, adi, bemargadga guegar.
Deginbali, Bab-Jehová, bega-sogsadba, be-asabin be-isdarmalad-ononnogoed.”
Moisés Israel-dulemarga sogdebalid: “Yoedsega, be-mimmi bese egichialile: ‘Ar we-Igargan-Mamaid, Bab-Dummad-Jehová-Sogedba-Igargan-Mamaid, degi, Igargan-soglesad-uksad, ¿ibi obare?’
Weyob be-machiga be sogoed: ‘Anmar Egipto-yargi Faraón-e-maiga-gudigu, Bab-Jehová gandikidba Egipto-yargi anmar-onosad.

Bab-Jehová anmar-wagabsunna, ibmar-gegerdaklemalad, ibmar-dummagan-dakledisurmalad, degine, ibmar-dummagan-gegerdaklemalad Egipto-yargi imaksad. Bab-Jehová-Faraónʼgi-gwisgusad anmar daksad, degi, Faraón-e-neguyaginmaladgi-gwisgusad anmar daksabalid.
Bab-Jehová Egipto-yargi anmar-onosad. Ede, anmar-dadganga yar-ukedseye-sogsadse anmar-senonikid.
Bab-Dummad-Jehová anmarga sogsad, bela-e-Igar-uksadba anmarde nanamaloye. E-dobekwaa nanamaloye, adi, anmarga bela ibmar-nueganbi naegarye, degine, suiti-gudii guegarye, igi emi-ibadse anmar gudii.
